ItemID: NA; Title: SABRENT USB 3.2 Rugged Waterproof Enclosure [IP67] for M.2 NVMe SSDs (EC-WPNE); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I use external storage, but I have no current need to house a spare NVMe drive or waterproof it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Samsung PRO Endurance 32GB 100MB/s (U1) MicroSDXC Memory Card with Adapter (MB-MJ32GA/AM) , Black/White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have bought memory cards before, but I do not currently need a card designed for continuous recording.
ItemID: NA; Title: Apple 20W USB-C Power Adapter - iPhone Charger with Fast Charging Capability, Type C Wall Charger; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Mac accessories do not establish a need for an iPhone charger, so I would skip this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Logitech MX Keys Mini Minimalist Wireless Illuminated Keyboard, Compact, Bluetooth, Backlit, USB-C, Compatible with Apple macOS, iOS, Windows, Linux, Android, Metal Build - Graphite; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: I like wireless keyboards that work with my computers, but I recently bought a full-size Macally keyboard and would keep using it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Cube, Hands-free streaming device with Alexa, 4K Ultra HD, includes latest Alexa Voice Remote; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my Alexa and streaming setup, but my recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max already serves that purpose.

ItemID: NA; Title: SanDisk 256GB Extreme microSDXC UHS-I Memory Card with Adapter - Up to 160MB/s, C10, U3, V30, 4K, A2, Micro SD - SDSQXA1-256G-GN6MA; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Removable storage interests me, but I would check my devices' capacity support and identify a specific use before buying.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with clock and Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: I like the Echo devices I have selected, but I recently bought the same generation Dot and an Echo Show, so another feels unnecessary now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Apple MagSafe Charger - Wireless Charger with Fast Charging Capability, Type C Wall Charger, Compatible with iPhone and AirPods; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no established need for charging a MagSafe-compatible iPhone or AirPods.
ItemID: NA; Title: eufy Security Indoor Cam E220, Pan & Tilt, Indoor Security Camera, 2K - 3 MP Wi-Fi Plug-in, Voice Assistant Compatibility, Night Vision, Motion Tracking, HomeBase 3 Compatible, Motion Only Alert; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My door alarm purchase suggests some security interest, but I do not currently have a reason to add indoor video monitoring.
